text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Oversized burgundy deep-V chunky knit sweater over dark inner top, dark micro pleated skirt, sheer black line-pattern tights shown hollow, tan faux-fur tall boot covers over chunky black shoes.
original_prompt: Edit this wardrobe product image: Remove all flesh-toned legs inside the black geometric line-pattern tights. The hosiery must be empty, with neutral pale gray transparent fabric and white backdrop visible through it, absolutely no skin, knees or anatomical leg surface. Keep every other garment and the shoes unchanged. No person, body parts, skin, visible mannequin, additional accessories or text. Pure white background, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped.
